detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for AWS (`Splunk_TA_aws`, Splunkbase 1876) with the modular input for `aws:cur`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.1.78.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `product_product_name` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable billing integration in AWS and forward findings/logs via `Splunk_TA_aws` into `index=aws` with `sourcetype=aws:cur`. Validate field extractions before alerting.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur"
| table _time product_product_name lineItem_UsageAmount lineItem_UnblendedCost
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.156_aws_cur_daily_cost_anoma_156"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cur` in `index=aws` to detect aws cur daily cost anomaly. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS Cost Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `product_product_name` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_1_156_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Notable-style table, severity timeline, single-value open finding count..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for AWS (`Splunk_TA_aws`, Splunkbase 1876) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of aws cur daily cost anomaly so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
